questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.q: The following effect is known as___
questions.solution: Electromeric effect is a temporary effect in which a shared pair of electrons (π-electron pair) is completely transferred from a double or a triple bond to one of the atoms joined by the bond at the requirement of attacking species. The Electromeric effect is represented by symbol E, and is said to be + E when the displacement of π electrons is away from the atom or group, and - E when displacement of π electrons are towards the atom or group. If the multiple bond is present between two different atoms, the electron shift will take place in the direction of the more electronegative atom. Hence, the following effect is known as Electromeric effect.

(ii) The tangent drawn to a line of force represents the direction of electric field.
(iii) The electric field lines never intersect.

questions.solution:
The electric field lines originates from a positive charge and ends at a negative charge and these field lines are also known as electric lines of forces. The direction of electric filed lines is from positive to negative. 

One of the properties of the electric lines of forces is, the tangent drawn at a point on the electric field gives the direction of electric force.

Therefore, the electric field lines never form a closed-loop because if they do, there will be two directions of forces at the point of intersection which is not possible for electric lines of forces.

Force experienced by a charge q in an electric field is, F=qE if the charge is -q or negative test change then force isF=-qE. Thus, a negative test charge experiences a force opposite to the direction of the field.

Option (i) and (iii) are true

questions.q:
Assertion (A): Two identical trains move in opposite senses in equatorial plane with same speeds relative to the earth's surface. They have equal magnitude of normal reaction.
Reason (R): The trains have different centripetal accelerations due to different speeds.
options: Both A and R are true and R is a correct explanation for A
Both A and R are true but R is not a correct explanation for A
questions.solution:
The train which is moving along the direction of rotation of earth that is west to east, will require less centripetal force compared to train moving in opposite direction.

Since the centripetal force is more on the train which move along the direction of rotation of earth therefore the normal reaction acting on the train will be more.

The centripetal force is the function of relative angular velocity of earth and train, therefore the train will have different acceleration because of relative angular velocity between train and earth not due to different speed.
